title: How a P-Trap Protects Your Home: The Liquid Seal Principle
description: A P-trap is a fundamental component of sink drainage designed to hold a standing barrier of clean water. Under normal operation, wastewater pushes through the curved dip of the trap and flows into the branch drain. When the flow stops, gravity retains a precise volume of water in the lower bend, forming a continuous hydraulic seal. This water barrier prevents sewer gas, odorous vapor, and pests from rising back through the sink drain into the living space. Maintaining proper trap slope, depth, and fixture clearance ensures optimal self-scouring velocity while protecting indoor air quality.

How a P-Trap Protects Your Home: The Liquid Seal Principle

A P-trap is a fundamental component of sink drainage designed to hold a standing barrier of clean water. Under normal operation, wastewater pushes through the curved dip of the trap and flows into the branch drain. When the flow stops, gravity retains a precise volume of water in the lower bend, forming a continuous hydraulic seal. This water barrier prevents sewer gas, odorous vapor, and pests from rising back through the sink drain into the living space. Maintaining proper trap slope, depth, and fixture clearance ensures optimal self-scouring velocity while protecting indoor air quality.
